title: Herbal Vine Braised Leaves
description: A unique and flavorful dish that combines the taste of herbal tea with the tenderness of braised leaves. This recipe is perfect for a relaxing evening.

ingredients.name: Fresh leaves
ingredients.notes: Choose a mix of leafy greens

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped leaves and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, Algerian herbal tea leaves, and bake seasoning mix.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let braise for 20 minutes.
If using honey, stir in during the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional leaves if desired.
